id_and_class.summary: Pacheco holds that matter and consciousness form one continuum, with matter running from dense physical states to subtle spiritual ones. Consciousness is fundamental and filters down through these densities in an inverted fractal pattern, from omniscience to total unconsciousness. A ‘non-causal dimension’ of mathematical indeterminacy gives consciousness genuine free will.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness and Matter as One Fractal Continuum

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is a fundamental aspect of a single reality in which matter and spirit are different condensations of the same substance.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Matter and spirit lie on one continuum of densities, and consciousness interacts with this structure as it becomes more refined. Pacheco rejects both materialist reduction and dualist separation.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable: consciousness is fundamental, and its levels result from filtering through denser states of matter.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: A continuum of material densities up to spiritual states; higher frequential dimensions in which universes with different Standard Models of physics share the same space; a non-causal dimension of mathematical indeterminacy; a universal intelligence.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through cosmology, physics, and philosophy, alongside spirituality treated as a complement to empirical science.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: An inverted fractal hierarchy from the infinitesimal to the macroscopic. Levels of consciousness run from omniscient through intuitive, rational, instinctive, and automated, down to total unconsciousness.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Levels of consciousness; free will; the relation of matter to spirit.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: An inverted fractal filtering of consciousness through layered densities, plus a non-causal dimension that frees consciousness from deterministic law.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Perception and material states evolve together: as matter organizes into more refined states, consciousness interacts with the changing structure.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Spread across all densities and across parallel frequency realities that coexist in the same space at different vibrational levels.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness acts with genuine autonomy through the non-causal dimension, which Pacheco says grounds true free will.
core_claims_and_evidence: Matter and spirit are condensations of the same reality, the spiritual levels being the least condensed.
Universes with different Standard Models coexist in the same space at distinct vibrational levels, each with its own physical constants.
At the infinitesimal limit physical laws break down: light has zero speed, time is an instant, and space is a singularity, which removes deterministic constraints.
This mathematical indeterminacy lets consciousness function independently of deterministic rules.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Speculative synthesis of cosmology (multiverses, higher dimensions), mathematics, and spiritual philosophy.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Key terms (density, frequency, vibrational level) are used in physics-like ways without definitions that would let them be measured. The step from mathematical indeterminacy at an infinitesimal limit to free will in conscious agents is asserted, not derived.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The coexistence of multiple Standard Models in parallel frequency realities remains speculative and untested.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Internally consistent as a monism that places matter and spirit on one scale, though its use of physical vocabulary departs from standard physics.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since spirit is a less condensed form of the same reality as matter, the framework leaves room for consciousness to continue at subtler levels, though Pacheco does not spell this out.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Pacheco links physical law to a universal intelligence and presents reality as a structured, interconnected whole that science and spirituality can jointly explore.

related_theories.name: Carr's Quantum Theory, Psi, Mental Space

sources_and_references.title_with_names: Pacheco’s Science of Unity (Landscape of Consciousness), Paulo De Luca Pacheco
